page.overview:
Who is Don Crumlin?

Don Crumlin is a character in Cars 2. He is a Gremlin who works for Professor Z. He is seen on the Oil Rigs.

According to the 2012 die-cast line, he appeared in the film as one of many Lemons working at the Oil Rig. Once C.H.R.O.M.E. agent Finn McMissile is spotted spying on the Lemons' plans, Crumlin and many others chase after the agent in an attempt to capture and kill him. Unfortunately for him, Finn sets a bomb and he is blown apart along with many other Lemons.

In Cars 2: The Video Game, he appears in Attack and Hunter mode as cars that the player has to destroy. They can shoot missiles or machine guns, putting them in the hard difficulty.

Like all the other Lemons, Don Crumlin is a cold-hearted terrorist who would do anything for a quick buck.
